title: Root paired Mobile canonical full gate
request: Repair the failing Root PR quality check without weakening coverage or increasing individual Jest timeouts.
outcome: Root paired full regression now delegates to the Mobile repository's canonical full gate, preserving all Mobile audits, type checks, lint, button checks, fast tests, and the complete 826-test Jest suite while running the full suite serially as the Mobile release gate defines.
implementation: Replace Root's ad-hoc Mobile typecheck, lint, and default parallel Jest command with the Mobile repository's maintained check:full contract.
Keep the Mobile repository responsible for its own full-gate composition, including serial full Jest execution, instead of duplicating a divergent Root-side command.
Add a Root quality-contract regression that fails if check:mobile returns to raw parallel npm test or stops invoking Mobile check:full.
impact_dependencies: CI only: no runtime API, database, migration, environment, package-lock, dependency, web, backend, or Mobile application behavior change.
Paired validation depends on Mobile Dev at 2f30696ee160f17c2774e5be0039bf79ed74d0d2.
Related release units: root/CRL-20261103-003 and mobile/CRL-20261103-005.
validation: The former Root command was reproduced against current Mobile Dev: default parallel Jest changed the timeout failure to InspectionPanelScreen while the affected business suites passed, proving resource-sensitive orchestration rather than one failed assertion.
CI=true npm run check:mobile passed the canonical Mobile gate: ledger tests and audit, typecheck, lint with zero errors, button audit, 8 suites / 138 fast tests, and 84 suites / 826 full tests.
CI=true npm run check:full passed the exact paired Root chain: backend build and contract suite, Web 57 files / 314 tests plus production build, and Mobile canonical 84 suites / 826 tests.
risks: The canonical Mobile gate performs more governance checks than the former ad-hoc command and may add CI duration; rollback is the package.json command plus its contract test.
Existing non-failing Mobile lint warnings and React act warnings remain visible and are not suppressed.
The historical ledger remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is not included in this change; no secret, credential, production record, or generated artifact is added.
